{{Top|Canon=Kin/Canon}}
{{Quote|Welcome, my children. I am King Ommin!|King [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]|audio=IamKingOmmin.flac|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi (audio)">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
[[File:Katuunko-SWE.png|thumb|right|180px|King [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]] of [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]]]]

A '''king''' was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] head of a monarchic government. The female equivalent was the [[Queen/Legends|queen]]. Some planets, such as [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]], were ruled by an elective monarchy. Others, like [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]], had a hereditary position. Some, such as the [[Godking]]s of [[Abonshee]], were worshiped as gods. Several governments in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] had kings.

*"[[King of Mon Cala/Legends|King of Mon Cala]]" was the title held by the ruler of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Mon Calamari. [[Yos Kolina/Legends|Yos Kolina]] was its eighty-second king, succeeded by his son, [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]].<ref name="SWE-Mon Cala">{{SWE|locations|moncala|Mon Cala}}</ref>

*One of the leaders of the [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] species possessed the title of king.<ref name="SW104">[[Star Wars (1977) 104|''Star Wars'' (1977) 104]]</ref>

*The King of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]] was also known as the [[Sith'ari/Legends|Sith'ari]].<ref name="Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>

*Before the establishment of a [[theocracy]] on [[Nazzri]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5002 BBY]], the [[Nazzar/Legends|Nazzar]] were ruled by figure with the double title of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]-King. Thereafter the planetary ruler was merely entitled King.<ref name="ToftJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref>

Not all kings had absolute power. In some cases, they were the highest authority, while in others, such as the [[Blood Monarch/Legends|Blood Monarchs]] of [[Thisspias/Legends|Thisspias]], it was Parliament who did most of the government running. In general, however, their authority and influence was superseded by those holding the title of Emperor or Empress.
